subject.title: [Feature]: Include Automation identity and definition revision in hook context

question: Should OpenClaw make Automation job identity and admission-time definition revision a supported public plugin-hook contract, rather than leaving Automation attribution to existing general tracing fields?
rationale: The requested fields are intended for audit and authorization consumers, so their meaning, snapshot timing, and long-term compatibility cannot safely be chosen by an automated repair lane.

options.title: Adopt a narrow Automation envelope
options.body: Add an optional, documented Automation identity envelope with job ID, run ID, and admission-time revision to the relevant hook contexts and test its immutability.

options.title: Fold it into broad tracing work
options.body: Extend the canonical observability design first, then decide whether Automation identity is a trace attribute or a separate hook contract.

options.title: Keep hooks generic
options.body: Decline a dedicated Automation envelope and direct authorization plugins to an existing supported attribution seam if one is approved as sufficient.

recommendation.title: Adopt a narrow Automation envelope
recommendation.body: Add an optional, documented Automation identity envelope with job ID, run ID, and admission-time revision to the relevant hook contexts and test its immutability.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue explicitly requests this owner’s confirmation, and the decision affects the durable public plugin hook contract.
